name: Enchant player Curses — nobody until a player is picked; Enchant opponent lists opponents only; creatures attacking that player
notes: Found by tests/audit.py once Enchant player Auras were audited (2026-11-17). A Curse just added read "enchanted player" as you: Curse of Death's Hold shrank its own controller's creatures until a player was picked. Now an effect scoped to the enchanted player (or to "target player") reaches nobody until one is picked (engine-deps.js), as "target opponent" already did. "Enchant opponent" (Tenuous Truce) was not read as enchanting a player at all, so it had no player list; it is now, and the list leaves you out (_enchantOpponentOnly, getPlayerCandidates 'enchanted'). "Creatures attacking enchanted player have trample" (Curse of Hospitality) reached nobody: "creatures attacking you" is now a subject (cards-text-utils.js).

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Runeclaw Bear
scryfallData.flavor_text: The magic of the elves leaves its mark on the forest. The magic of the forest leaves its mark on the animals who live there. The animals of the forest leave their mark on all who trespass.

scryfallData.name: Curse of Death's Hold
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Enchant player
Creatures enchanted player controls get -1/-1.
scryfallData.flavor_text: "May you and all your kin waste and wither until your clan is no more!"

scryfallData.name: Curse of Conformity
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Enchant player
Nonlegendary creatures enchanted player controls have base power and toughness 3/3 and lose all creature types.
scryfallData.flavor_text: Whether you'll fit in isn't up to you at all.

scryfallData.name: Curse of Hospitality
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Enchant player
Creatures attacking enchanted player have trample.
Whenever a creature deals combat damage to enchanted player, that player exiles the top card of their library. Until end of turn, that creature's controller may play that card and they may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast that spell.

scryfallData.name: Tenuous Truce
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Enchant opponent
At the beginning of enchanted opponent's end step, you and that player each draw a card.
When you attack enchanted opponent or a planeswalker they control or when they attack you or a planeswalker you control, sacrifice this Aura.
